title: A thin-bridge criterion for strong ample stability of quiver dimension vectors
difficulty_reason: The authors use the cited Kac quadratic decomposition and a sign analysis of its two terms, first excluding two partial-coordinate vertices and then treating one partial vertex by a graph decomposition and Euler-form bounds. The remaining zero-or-full-coordinate case forces a unique edge whose endpoint dimensions are one, contradicting the no-thin-bridge condition. This combinatorial argument is carried in the appendix and is distinct from the Teleman cohomology calculation in existing 2372. The literal sign discrepancy at line 2540 is retained for reviewer assessment.
